title: Which Sanrio character are you? Free quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Sanrio character quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're Hello Kitty, My Melody, Kuromi, Cinnamoroll, Pompompurin, Pochacco, Keroppi or Badtz-Maru. Unofficial fan quiz, no sign-up.
lede: Sweet like My Melody, a little rebellious like Kuromi or sleepy like Pompompurin? Answer 12 questions about your snacks, your style and your friends to find your Sanrio match.
about: Sanrio's characters have been on pencil cases, plushies and phone cases around the world since Hello Kitty first appeared in 1974. Each has a personality fans know well: Hello Kitty is kind and loves her friends, My Melody is sweet and honest, Kuromi is mischievous with a soft side, Cinnamoroll is a shy dreamer who can fly with his ears, Pompompurin loves naps and pudding, Pochacco is sporty and curious, Keroppi is cheerful and adventurous, and Badtz-Maru is a cheeky penguin who acts tough. This quiz matches you with one of these eight.

Your result names your character and shows your scores for all eight. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Sanrio; the names belong to their owners.

faq.a: Hello Kitty, My Melody, Kuromi, Cinnamoroll, Pompompurin, Pochacco, Keroppi and Badtz-Maru.

faq.q: Is one result rarer than the others?
faq.a: No. Every character appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.

kitty.name: Hello Kitty
kitty.body: You are kind, cheerful and the friend everyone loves to be around. You love making things for others, sharing and bringing people together. Your warmth is your superpower; just remember you can say no sometimes too.

melody.name: My Melody
melody.body: You are sweet, honest and gentle, with a big heart and a love of baking and cute things. You tell the truth kindly and make people feel safe. Your softness hides a real inner strength.

kuromi.name: Kuromi
kuromi.body: You are a little rebellious, stylish and full of attitude, with a soft romantic side you don't show everyone. You like to stand out, you're loyal to your friends and you secretly care a lot. Edgy on the outside, sweet underneath.

cinnamoroll.name: Cinnamoroll
cinnamoroll.body: You are shy, dreamy and gentle, and you'd rather hang out with one close friend than a crowd. You're a great listener and your calm makes others feel at home. Your dreams are big, and you can reach them.

pompompurin.name: Pompompurin
pompompurin.body: You are laid-back, cuddly and always up for a nap or a snack. You don't stress about much, and people love how relaxed you are. You remind your friends that rest and pudding fix a lot of problems.

pochacco.name: Pochacco
pochacco.body: You are sporty, curious and full of energy. You love trying new things, playing games and getting outdoors, and you're always ready to cheer your friends up. Just try to sit still long enough to enjoy the moment.

keroppi.name: Keroppi
keroppi.body: You are cheerful, adventurous and great at bringing friends together. You love swimming, exploring and turning ordinary days into fun. Your positive energy is catching.

badtz.name: Badtz-Maru
badtz.body: You are cheeky, funny and a bit of a rebel, and you love a good prank. You act tough and cool, but you care about your friends more than you'd admit. You keep life interesting for everyone around you.
